description: List FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) events with optional filters - the discovery tool for finding event keys and browsing the season schedule. Returns an array of events with name, key, dates, location, week, type, EPA stats, and predictions. Filter by `year` (4-digit, >=2002), `country`, `state`, `district`, `type` (regional, district, district_cmp, champs_div, einstein, offseason), and `week` (0-8 of the season; 8 = championship). Sort with `metric`/`ascending` and paginate with `limit`/`offset`. Use this to answer "what regionals were in California in 2024?", "list all week 1 events this year", or "find the FRC championship divisions" (year=YEAR, type="champs_div"). If you need a single event you already know, use get_event.

ascending.description: Whether to sort in ascending order. Default is ascending.

country.description: Capitalized country name, e.g. USA or Canada.

district.description: District abbreviation. One of: ca, fch, fim, fin, fit, fma, fnc, fsc, isr, ne, ont, pch, pnw, win.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-1000). Default is 1000.

metric.description: How to sort the returned values. Any column in the table is valid.

offset.description: Offset from the first result to return.

state.description: Capitalized two-letter state code, e.g. NC.

type.description: One of: regional, district, district_cmp, champs_div, einstein, or offseason.

week.description: Week of the competition season. 8 is CMP.

name: get_events
